title: hive forget output (v1)
description: Stable contract emitted by `hive forget NAME --json`. Removes the named entry from the global registry (~/.config/hive/config.yml by default, or HIVE_HOME/config.yml when overridden). Does not touch the project's .hive-state directory on disk. By default, an unknown name is a USAGE error (64); with --if-exists, an already absent entry is a success payload with removed=false.

removed.description: True when a registry row was removed.

name.description: The name of the registry entry that was removed.

path.description: Absolute path the removed entry was bound to.

hive_state_path.description: Absolute path of the entry's .hive-state directory (informational; not deleted).

removed.description: False when --if-exists made an already absent entry a no-op success.

error_class.description: Short name (no module prefix) of the Hive::Error subclass that was raised. Matches every other hive-* error envelope.

error_kind.description: usage = malformed invocation rejected before command dispatch (exit 64). missing_name = NAME positional was empty/whitespace. unknown_project = NAME does not match any registry entry without --if-exists. config = malformed config.yml or missing $HIVE_HOME (exit 78). internal = uncategorised crash (exit 70).
